policy.connectivity_candidate_bound: One seed candidate per occupied cell plus6 neighbor candidates per reached cell; shares Faces Step budget, separate counters; requires every cell reachable from pinned seam rows before publication.

evidence: Exact geometry/RGB for old visual-v1 and new two-row-seam runtime-v2; clipping-oracle/contact/connectivity/budget/cancel/source-change/allocation tests; C#9/netstandard2.1 compile; 546 masked-mesher exact-face assertions on each fixture set.
upper_mesh_issue: Visual-v1 changed23/15 upper face AO attributes with identical upper geometry. Fixed canonical row29 restores stock upper face attributes; row30 is context only. Runtime-v2 pins both rows.
native_validation: V4 actual native four-image static two-site review passes; runtime/allLOD/wind/collision/Play/FPS remain open.
limitations: Unit scale only; no runtime pack template export/loading hook.
Step budgets bound candidates, not milliseconds, allocation latency, provider call latency or GC. Shared template validation/hashing is synchronous once per template.
No asynchronous worker/queue/cache, production integration, mesh upload, gameplay collision or authoritative world edit integration.
Raw faces are a conservative unmerged admission count; parent separately owns emission-domain mesher validation.
Geometry/matter volume changes require a production generator version and persisted provenance decision. No release identity assigned.
Provider must never reuse a source identity across mutations; API is single-owner, not thread-safe.
Only two natural mature sites plus synthetic gates; broad steep terrain, LOD, wind, lighting, live edit and native visual gates remain.
performance_scope: Earlier~12ms base+mesh is a smaller visual-v1 microbenchmark. The new full admission builder adds exact terrain queries, connectivity and raw-face checks; its single-pass JIT/GC measurements are separate and are not a frame budget.
interaction_gate: CPU implementation/oracles complete, not wired to live collision. OwnedY<=29; canonical context29..32. Last-owned and first-preserved labels match;8283upper live AVPM body/resistance queries match.
